access_grants_object_scope_check.name: access_grants_object_scope_check
access_grants_object_scope_check.value: ("access_grants"."object_type"::text IN ('page_site', 'page_route') AND "access_grants"."page_site_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("access_grants"."object_type"::text = 'meeting' AND "access_grants"."meeting_bot_id" IS NOT NULL)

managed_runtime_commands_session_executi.name: managed_runtime_commands_session_execution_active_unique
managed_runtime_commands_session_executi.where: "managed_runtime_commands"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "managed_runtime_commands"."action" <> 'turn_interrupt' AND "managed_runtime_commands"."status" IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'running')

managed_runtime_commands_session_interru.name: managed_runtime_commands_session_interrupt_active_unique
managed_runtime_commands_session_interru.where: "managed_runtime_commands"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "managed_runtime_commands"."action" = 'turn_interrupt' AND "managed_runtime_commands"."status" IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'running')

managed_runtime_events_session_source_un.name: managed_runtime_events_session_source_unique
managed_runtime_events_session_source_un.where: "managed_runtime_events"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "managed_runtime_events"."source_event_id" IS NOT NULL

managed_runtime_sessions_instance_sessio.name: managed_runtime_sessions_instance_session_key_unique
managed_runtime_sessions_instance_sessio.where: "managed_runtime_sessions"."instance_id" IS NOT NULL AND "managed_runtime_sessions"."session_key" IS NOT NULL

page_chat_rooms_kind_check.name: page_chat_rooms_kind_check
page_chat_rooms_kind_check.value: ("page_chat_rooms"."kind" = 'shared' AND "page_chat_rooms"."owner_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("page_chat_rooms"."kind" = 'private' AND "page_chat_rooms"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

provider_connections_user_account_unique.name: provider_connections_user_account_unique
provider_connections_user_account_unique.where: "provider_connections"."scope_kind" = 'user' AND "provider_connections"."external_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_connections"."status" NOT IN ('revoked_by_user', 'revoked_by_operator', 'revoked_by_provider')

provider_connections_org_account_unique.name: provider_connections_org_account_unique
provider_connections_org_account_unique.where: "provider_connections"."scope_kind" = 'organization' AND "provider_connections"."external_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_connections"."status" NOT IN ('revoked_by_user', 'revoked_by_operator', 'revoked_by_provider')
